case_fields.subject_group: pseudonymous grouping for splitting repeated cases
case_fields.evaluated_at: time for which an interpretation is requested
case_fields.evidence_available_until: cutoff to prevent using later observations in earlier predictions
case_fields.natal_context: observed natal facts; retain unknown fields

time_context.daewoon: supplied time context with calculator version; not computed in this prototype

case_fields.features: observed degree in [0,1] or null, with measurement policy and source
case_fields.interactions: explicit factors involving 2 or more features; arbitrary arity supported
case_fields.target: precise definition of the interpretation being modelled
case_fields.label: reviewed degree or binary outcome depending on declared target; no implicit label
case_fields.label_origin: expert/source annotation/empirical outcome must remain distinguishable

mapping_to_current_engine: features supplies conditional_model.predict context; metadata/time-context must be retained by caller. No automatic temporal feature extraction implemented.
